bullets: TRADITIONAL TEMPLE DESIGN: Features an intricately carved Goddess Lakshmi central pendant with delicate pearl drops, embodying classic South Indian craftsmanship.
EMBELLISHED COIN CHARMS: Adorned with four engraved gold-tone coin charms, each accented with pearl and coloured stone floral clusters in ruby red and emerald green.
ELEGANT CHAIN: Slim, twisted gold-tone chain with an adjustable hook-and-eye clasp, ensuring a comfortable and secure fit for various neckline styles.
VERSATILE STYLING: Pairs beautifully with traditional sarees, salwar suits, and ethnic wear, making it ideal for festivals, weddings, and cultural celebrations.
LIGHTWEIGHT AND WEARABLE: Delicate construction makes this necklace comfortable for all-day wear without compromising on its ornate, eye-catching appearance.
description: Elevate your traditional look with this exquisite gold-toned temple necklace, a timeless piece inspired by the rich heritage of South Indian jewellery. The delicate chain features five ornate coin-shaped charms engraved with a deity motif, each adorned with vibrant gemstone accents in ruby red and emerald green, surrounded by lustrous pearl clusters. The centrepiece pendant showcases a beautifully detailed Goddess Lakshmi figure, framed by a halo of pearls and finished with graceful pearl drops that add an elegant movement to the design. An adjustable hook clasp ensures a comfortable and secure fit. Perfect for pairing with silk sarees, lehengas, or festive ethnic wear, this necklace is an ideal choice for weddings, religious ceremonies, and cultural celebrations. A truly divine accessory that beautifully blends devotion with artistry.
